title.zh: OpenAI Says People Linked to China's Moonshot Tried to Copy Its AI's Hidden Reasoning
title.en: OpenAI Says People Linked to China's Moonshot Tried to Copy Its AI's Hidden Reasoning

current_state.zh: OpenAI says it disrupted a large-scale effort to extract its models' hidden reasoning traces, tracing a core cluster of the activity to people associated with China's Moonshot AI, maker of the Kimi chatbot.
current_state.en: OpenAI says it disrupted a large-scale effort to extract its models' hidden reasoning traces, tracing a core cluster of the activity to people associated with China's Moonshot AI, maker of the Kimi chatbot.

updates.title_zh: OpenAI称与中国月之暗面有关联的人员试图复制其AI的隐藏推理
updates.title_en: OpenAI Says People Linked to China's Moonshot Tried to Copy Its AI's Hidden Reasoning
updates.what_changed_zh:
OpenAI表示，它已阻止了一场有组织地提取其模型在作答前所生成隐藏推理的活动，并称该活动始于7月1日。仅在7月24日和25日两天，OpenAI就记录到来自4000多名用户的1.6万次提取请求，而整个用户群超过1.5万人；OpenAI称该活动已于7月28日被完全阻断。

OpenAI称，这些被提取的隐藏推理可能被用来训练另一个模型，从而绕过原有的安全防护。OpenAI表示，此后已关闭一条路径——该路径曾允许已持有他人加密推理内容的人通过重放来还原其内容。

OpenAI称，相关操作者“没有破解我们的加密、入侵数据库，也没有直接访问已存储的用户对话”，而是通过操纵模型交互，使受保护的推理能够以可见形式被复制，违反了其服务条款；其中一种方法是把一段对话中的加密推理复制出来，再让模型在另一段对话中解码。OpenAI还表示，尚不清楚所观察到的所有操作者是否来自同一行为体，但将这一活动的“核心集群”归因于与Kimi开发者月之暗面有关联的个人。

updates.background_zh: OpenAI此前有过类似指控：2025年1月，它表示正在审查DeepSeek可能蒸馏其模型的迹象，当时华盛顿正在评估国家安全风险。Anthropic随后在2月指控中国实验室使用约2.4万个欺诈账户与Claude进行了逾1600万次交互；到4月，白宫称外国实体——主要在中国——正在进行工业规模的蒸馏活动；6月，Anthropic呼吁国会对大规模模型提取行为施加处罚。8月，研究人员披露OpenAI、Anthropic和谷歌各自仅用一个覆盖全平台的加密密钥保护推理内容，攻击者可诱导模型以明文输出这些隐藏思路；三家公司在披露后均部署了服务端修复。
updates.background_en: OpenAI has made similar accusations before: in January 2025 it said it was reviewing signs that DeepSeek may have distilled its models, as Washington weighed national security risks. Anthropic followed in February, accusing Chinese labs of using about 24,000 fraudulent accounts to generate more than 16 million exchanges with Claude; by April the White House was describing industrial-scale distillation campaigns by foreign entities, primarily in China, and in June Anthropic asked Congress for penalties on large-scale model extraction. In August, researchers showed that OpenAI, Anthropic and Google each protected reasoning with a single provider-wide encryption key, and that attackers could coax models into outputting the hidden thoughts in plain text; all three deployed server-side patches after disclosure.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该披露并不直接涉及加密资产；其传导主要通过情绪面——围绕模型输出溯源和跨境AI知识产权争端的关注度上升，可能影响加密市场中的AI叙事板块，包括AI概念代币以及去中心化推理/算力网络。其传导渠道是叙事与监管关注，而非资金流或托管，且该报道本身不含任何市场数据。
updates.market_impact_en: The disclosure does not directly involve crypto assets; any transmission runs through sentiment, as renewed attention to model-output provenance and cross-border AI IP disputes can affect the AI-narrative segment of crypto markets, including AI-themed tokens and decentralized inference or compute networks. The channel is narrative and regulatory attention rather than cash flows or custody, and the report itself contains no market data.
